page_title: DAR 1-4 UNI | Darmstadt v Union Berlin 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
90+2' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
87' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) commits a foul and Patrick Ittrich immediately signals a free kick.
84' That will be all from Robin Gosens who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
84' Poor challenge! Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt) is penalised for tripping and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle.
83' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

82' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
78' The substitution has been made. Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) has replaced Marvin Mehlem.
77' Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
75' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
74' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul after Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) hacks down one of his opponents.
72' A player from Darmstadt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
71' Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
70' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
67' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Braydon Marvin Manu is replaced by Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt).
67' Matej Maglica will be replaced by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt).
67' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is able to continue to play.
66' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

65' 1 - 4 Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:4.
65' Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Kevin Volland.
64' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) replaces Aissa Laidouni.
64' Substitution. Kevin Behrens walks off the pitch and Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
63' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Marcel Schuhen.
60' Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
59' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
56' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
51' Patrick Ittrich blows the whistle, Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul.
49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Darmstadt.
47' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
47' CHANCE! Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post!
46' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
46' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) replacing Mathias Honsak.
46' Torsten Lieberknecht makes a half-time substitution. Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) comes on in place of Christoph Klarer.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Darmstadt are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45+2' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
44' The game is interrupted. Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
42' A short pass finds Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.

39' 1 - 3 Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) finds his way to a cross from the corner kick and heads it in via a deflection off the top of the right post. There was absolutely nothing Marcel Schuhen could do with it. The score changes to 1:3.
39' Union Berlin win a corner.
38' Now Darmstadt have a corner.
34' 1 - 2 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
34' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Patrick Ittrich ignores the protests.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
29' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
25' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) replaces David Datro Fofana.
24' 1 - 1 Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
21' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from Patrick Ittrich and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
18' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
18' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.

17' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Marcel Schuhen makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball goes behind for a corner. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' What a big chance! Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
11' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

10' Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
9' Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
7' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) meets a cross inside the box, but Marcel Schuhen wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
7' A player from Darmstadt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
5' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
4' 0 - 1 Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Darmstadt will kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich is introduced as the referee for today's match.
